answers.rationale: The requirement specifies terminal block wiring and labeling within a metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product is the default for metal-clad switchgear lines, and it includes the necessary wiring and terminal block arrangements.

This requirement pertains to the representation of devices and wiring within switchgear enclosures. The CROWN-ARMV product is suitable as it is designed for metal-clad switchgear and includes detailed wiring and device arrangements.
The requirement specifies control and lockout switches within switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product includes such components as part of its standard offering for metal-clad switchgear.

This requirement involves furnishing protective relays and programming them for operational switchgear. The EP2-RPP product is specifically designed for relay and protection panels, including programming and settings.
The requirement specifies semi-flush panel mounting of instruments and relays on switchgear front doors. The CROWN-ARMV product includes such features as part of its metal-clad switchgear design.

The requirement specifies silver-plated contacts for switching devices and secondary disconnecting devices. The CROWN-ARMV product includes these features as part of its standard metal-clad switchgear offering.
The requirement specifies accessories and spare parts for switchgear. The CROWN-ACC product provides catalog accessories for MV switchgear, which would include the specified items.
The requirement specifies a tube of contact lubricant as a spare part. The CROWN-ACC product includes accessories and spare parts for MV switchgear, which would cover this item.
The requirement specifies a remote racking device with a push-button station and motor operator. The CROWN-ACC product includes accessories for MV switchgear, which would include such devices.
